_schema.doc: Skill-description budget exemption registry (SPEC 4.4 — cross-repo docs/prompts/2026-07-17-skill-description-token-contract-SPEC.md). USER-EDITED ONLY: the delta auditor (dhx/dhx-skill-desc-audit.cjs) and the skills-repo collector READ this file and never write it. For skills that cannot carry desc-budget frontmatter (plugin caches clobbered on update; gsd tree rewritten by installer).

entry.slug: required — skill slug as the collector reports it
entry.source: optional — substring match against the collector source (e.g. 'chrome-devtools-plugins'); omit to match the slug in any source
entry.max_chars: required — approved cap; validity = slug(+source) + max_chars (approves context SPEND, not exact prose)
entry.last_reviewed_sha256: optional — sha256 of the normalized description at approval; a mismatch triggers a ONE-TIME re-review notice (never invalidates the exemption); refresh it to acknowledge a content change
entry.approved: required by convention — ISO date of user approval
entry.reason: required by convention — why the exemption exists
